Beastslayer
100 Focus
Instant
Requires One-Handed Melee Weapon
Deals Weapon Damage plus 50 to an enemy target, increasing based on how full your Focus bar is.

After using this ability, your melee attack power is increased by 15%, and the cost of this ability is reduced by 15% for 30 sec, stacks up to 3 times.
